title: Decent lower end mixer but wouldn't recommend for HEAVY DUTY stuff like dough...
text:
Decent lower end mixer but wouldn't recommend for HEAVY DUTY stuff like dough.... None of these lower end mixers and even the Kitchenaid mixers anymore can withstand heavy stuff like mixing thick dough. It'll burn them all up and break their parts. Kitchenaid was great for that when Hobart made their motors but since then, even they can't withstand that stuff. Just saying if they can't do it, this off brand REALLY can't. So get this knowing that you'll pretty much be using it for cake mixes and mixing things in general. And with that, I say you might check out other brands, you can find one half of this price that does the same thing! This things not super high powered and it's all plastic so I have no idea why it costs so much.

It works okay for mixing and looks nice but I accidentally dropped it in the kitchen from like 2 feet and it shattered into pieces! It still works, just looks like it got ran over by a car now. Don't really recommend this one at all unless they dumped the price down.

product_metadata.title: CHeflee Stand Mixer, 6 Quart, 600W 6+P Speed Household Electric Food Mixer with 6 Accessories for Dough, Cream, Cake, Kitchen Electric Mixer, Lavender
features: [600W Powerful Motor] A good bread depends on whether it’s pliable. The stand mixer has 660W powerful motor to enable it only needs 5-10 Minutes to knead into Glove Film. And that’s the key of a loaf of Fluffy and Stretchy Bread.

[6+P Speed &Spring Tilt Lock] 6 speeds can meet your different mixing needs, from low speed string to high speed whipping cream. The electric mixer tilt lock can lock the head when it’s lifted up to make sure it won’t drop heavily, interior spring ensures the head can down slowly and no need to make a force to lift it up. It also allows access to install or uninstall bowl and accessories easily.

[Planetary Mixing Action] CHeflee mixers kitchen electric stand mixer simulates the trajectories of planets, rotate while simultaneously moving around the bowl to make sure food to be mixed more thorough and avoiding any mixture getting stuck around the edge of the bowl while in use.

[Rich Accessories] 6 QT SUS304 bowl is very suitable for a family. The food mixer also comes with a die-cast aluminum dough hook, beater, stainless steel egg whisk, egg white separator, splash guard, spatula and dust cover. All these accessories are dishwasher-safe and very easy to clean up.

[Superior Quality] The interior gears are all made of strong metal，which make sure of lower-lever noise(68-75 Db) and longer service life. 5 anti-slip feet increase the machine steady and avoid moving or bounce during operation. There is also a vent behind the tilt-head to increase heat dissipation.
